topic: How does L-DACS integration impact spectrum sharing between A2G and satellite links in congested airspaces?
consensus_response: L-DACS integration optimizes spectrum sharing through FDD and TDD techniques, minimizing interference. Adaptive modulation and beamforming enhance spectral efficiency, mitigate interference, and reduce Doppler shift effects. Dynamic spectrum management and coordination between networks ensure reliable communication services in congested airspaces.
reference_context: L-DACS mitigates VHF band saturation, providing secure data services. FDD and TDD techniques enable efficient spectrum sharing between A2G and satellite links.
